before.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: BEFORE photograph for a luxury makeup-school website's precisely aligned before/after image slider. Generate ONE single landscape image, 1536x1024 (3:2), not a collage, not a split face. Subject: a fictional adult woman aged around 28, warm medium olive skin, dark brown eyes, dark brown hair neatly pulled back into a low bun, wearing a plain black crew-neck top, no jewelry. Head and upper shoulders portrait, facing straight at camera, centered, eyes level, straight neck, a relaxed self-assured neutral expression and closed lips. Keep the entire head within frame, a little space above the hair and generous quiet space on both sides. Face approximately 42% of image width. Bare face with NO visible makeup: natural unpainted lips, natural eyebrows and eyelashes, no eyeliner, no eyeshadow, no mascara, no foundation, no blush. Realistic flattering skin with pores, fine texture and subtle natural tonal variation. This is a beautiful natural face, never an intentionally unflattering 'before'. Background: seamless solid light warm grey taupe studio wall, extremely subtle gradient. Soft large diffuse frontal studio light with slight direction from camera-left, realistic catchlights. High-end editorial beauty photography, 85mm lens look, crisp detailed eyes and skin, neutral color grading. This image will be edited later to add makeup ONLY; make pose and camera absolutely stable and simple. No beauty filter, no face reshaping, no retouched plastic skin, no hands, no objects, no text, no labels, no logos or watermark.

after.initialPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: AFTER image for a precisely registered before/after makeup comparison slider on a makeup-school website. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and must remain the same photograph. Edit ONLY the visible makeup on this adult woman's face. Preserve her exact identity, facial anatomy, head shape, jaw, nose, lips shape, eye size and position, eyebrows position, hairline, flyaway hairs, hairstyle, pose, gaze, neutral expression, ears, neck, black shirt, background, lighting, shadows, framing, camera and image dimensions 1536x1024. Absolutely no change in zoom, rotation, facial proportions, posture, smile or background. Do not regenerate a different portrait. Add a polished professional modern beauty makeup look: rich softly blended plum-brown eyeshadow with subtle champagne sheen on the eyelids, neat dark brown-to-black eyeliner with a refined small wing, defined softly volumized eyelashes, naturally filled brows preserving their hair texture and shape, even satin complexion retaining real pores, softly sculpted warm rose blush and gentle highlights, carefully defined muted rose-mauve satin lipstick. Make the makeup difference clear and refined, wearable editorial glam, neither costume nor extravagant. Keep the original skin's underlying color, face details and all geometry; makeup pigments and cosmetics are the ONLY change. No skin whitening, no face slimming, no cosmetic surgery effect, no plastic retouching, no removing characteristic details, no larger eyes or lips. Return one complete photograph, not a collage or split-face, no words, no labels, no logo, no watermark. Alignment with the original is the priority because the two images will overlap at the exact same pixel positions in an interactive slider.
after.refinementPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the edit target, an already aligned AFTER makeup photo. Make ONE targeted change: intensify only the makeup pigments to a clearly visible refined evening glam, so the before/after website slider has a meaningful visual change. On the eyelids use a richer visible plum/burgundy smoky gradient, champagne shimmer on inner lid, a precise slim dark wing and softly defined lashes. On the lips use a deeper medium berry-rose satin lipstick, noticeably richer than the natural lip color but not black or extreme. Keep subtle warm rose blush and natural satin complexion. Preserve EXACTLY the identity, face geometry, all facial landmarks, gaze, expression, head/neck/shoulders position, hair including all strands, skin color, realistic skin texture, ears, clothing, background, shadows, lighting, crop and 1536x1024 dimensions. Do not alter anything except cosmetic pigment intensity; no reshaping or enlargement of facial features, no blur or plastic skin. It must remain the identical photograph. One complete photo, no text or collage.
